t: Ready-mixed filler for plasterboard jointing and surface finishing. Can be applied manually or with an airless spray machine. Easy to sand and apply with minimal shrinkage. Suitable for interior use on painted or unpainted substrates including gypsum plaster, plasterboard, old painted surfaces, any filler, cement, concrete, cellular concrete, breeze blocks, bricks and stone. Overcoat with any filler, any conventional paints and wall coverings.
